description:
Search drugs by name, target, or mechanism of action.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table drug_molecule — one record = one ChEMBL molecule (a parent compound or one of its salt forms).
Key: id.
Arguments: target_id accepts ensembl gene or hgnc symbol (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: ranked by id asc (verified by the harness); `_vbt.total` counts all matches; `_vbt.grains.molecule` counts molecules; `_vbt.grains.parent_molecule` counts parent_molecules.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. ChEMBL molecules integrated by OT 25.09 (existence only).

query.description: A case-insensitive substring search: every stored value containing the text is pooled into the results and counted in `_vbt.total`.

target_id.description: Accepts ensembl_gene, hgnc_symbol; resolved to one identifier (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
